description: Strands Agents agent run with one tool call, traced with the latest GenAI semantic conventions.
notes: The same program as strands-agent-tool, with OTEL_SEMCONV_STABILITY_OPT_IN set to gen_ai_latest_experimental in the scenario. Content is on gen_ai.client.inference.operation.details events, one key each per chat span (M4 spike, finding 6). event_loop.cycle_id and event_loop.parent_cycle_id are UUIDs per run and are volatile. gen_ai.server.time_to_first_token is an integer in milliseconds and is a timing attribute.
